monitored_text: Resources Design Guides Mini Guide: Liquid Cold Plates Mini Guide: Liquid Cold Plates Design better liquid cold plates the first time. This guide covers channel dimensions, materials, sealing methods, and finishing recommendations for machined cold plates. Download the Guide Liquid cold plates are one of the most common custom CNC-machined parts in high-performance electronics cooling, yet many engineers encounter the same avoidable design pitfalls when designing them for the first time. Our cold plate mini guide covers the key considerations for designing a CNC-machined cold plate: channel geometry and minimum dimensions, material selection, cover plate sealing methods, port and fitting placement, surface finish, and common post-processing options. Each recommendation includes a brief explanation of the reasoning behind it, so the guidelines are easier to apply to your specific design. It's intended as a practical starting point for engineers designing custom cold plates for data centers, AI accelerators, and power electronics — whether it's your first design or a revision of an existing one.
